channel.title: DR Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from DR Congo, every source cited.

item.title: DR Congo families urged to rebuild state values
item.description: Academics and NGO leaders call for families to instill civic and moral values for national reconstruction.

item.title: DR Congo prime minister submits 2027 budget to assembly
item.description: Judith Suminwa Tuluka presented the draft finance law for the upcoming fiscal year on October 31, 2026.

item.title: Kinshasa assembly considers funeral management law
item.description: A proposed law in Kinshasa aims to regulate funeral organization, morgue operations, and cemetery management.

item.title: Four killed in attack on army position in Ituri
item.description: A soldier and three militia members died in the Thursday, October 29 attack in Bule-centre.

item.title: Kinshasa parents worry over children's sugar intake
item.description: Sweet treats sold for as little as 100 Congolese francs are easily accessible near schools.
